title: Text Detective
summary: Filter synthetic logs into a compact evidence note.
description: Logs are records of events. The exercise dataset is synthetic and deliberately small. Search for authentication failures and the successful administrator event, then create `evidence/log-findings.txt` with verified counts.
learning_objectives: Use grep to search for patterns

workspace_seed.logs/auth.log:

2026-04-01T08:07:01Z AUTH_FAIL user=dev source=10.0.0.4

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Treat this as a filtering exercise: first understand the log format, then narrow it to relevant event types.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Read `logs/auth.log`, then combine `grep` with `wc -l` or inspect matching lines directly.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Create `evidence/log-findings.txt` with lines `failed_login=3` and `admin_login=1`. The source log includes exactly three `AUTH_FAIL` entries and one `ADMIN_LOGIN` entry.

completion_explanation: You completed Text Detective. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
